title: Formulary Benefit Listing Standards Schedule
content:
These standards govern how drugs are placed on each formulary of the Formulary Benefit: OTC equivalents, compounded prescriptions, biosimilars, the specialty-tier cost threshold, newly launched drugs, and quantity limits on excepted drugs.

| Standard | Exclusive | Value | Standard | Preferred Drug List | Broad | Open |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brand with an OTC equivalent in the same strength excluded | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no |
| Compounded prescriptions | excluded | excluded | covered with prior authorization | covered with prior authorization | covered with prior authorization | covered |
| Interchangeable biosimilar preferred over the reference biologic | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Specialty-tier threshold, allowed cost per 30-day supply (USD) | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Days a newly launched drug stays non-formulary pending P&T review | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 90 | 0 |
| Utilization management quantity limits still apply to a drug covered by exception | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

The columns are the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary, Northbridge Preferred Drug List, Northbridge Broad Formulary and Northbridge Open Formulary.

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Biosimilar preference.** Where an interchangeable biosimilar is preferred, the reference biologic moves to NF or to the non-preferred specialty tier.
2. **Specialty threshold.** A drug whose allowed cost per 30-day supply is above USD 1000 is placed on a specialty tier.
3. **New-to-market figure of 0.** On the Northbridge Open Formulary a newly launched drug is covered from launch at tier 3, the tier at which an approved non-formulary exception covers a non-specialty drug. On the other formularies a newly launched drug is treated as NF for the number of days shown.
4. **Quantity limits.** A drug covered by an exception keeps the quantity limits of the member's Utilization Management Program.

*Hypothetical reading.* Suppose a drug's allowed cost per 30-day supply is USD 1000 exactly. It is not above the threshold, so the specialty-tier placement standard does not place it on a specialty tier. At USD 1000.01 it would be placed there.
